江颜明显打扮了一番，穿着一件鹅黄色旗袍，裙子开叉到大腿根，雪白美腿暴露在外，再配上那绝美的容颜，简直诱人犯罪。“青云，你发什么愣，快进来啊！”江颜催促道。“颜姐，是你太美了！要是你没结婚，我绝对天天守在你家门口追求你……”陈青云吞了口唾沫，眼神火辣。察觉到他的目光，江颜害羞的同时又有些窃喜，连忙拉着他进来。“你在客厅休息一会儿，我再烧两个菜就好了！”江颜走进厨房，没多久就做了一桌子丰盛佳肴，色香味俱全。然而，到了约定的时间，杨天明却没有出现。江颜想要打电话催一催，陈青云却拉住她的手：“颜姐，杨副县长公务繁忙，估计在加班，我等一等也是应该的！”“那好吧。”江颜点了点头。这一等，足足等到了两个多小时。一桌饭菜都凉了，杨天明这才醉醺醺回来，明显刚在外面应酬，身上还有女人的香水味。“天明，你怎么才回来？不是和你说过，我远房表弟要来请你吃饭么？”江颜冷着脸，有些不悦。“有个饭局，实在推不掉！这就是你那个远房亲戚啊？”杨天明半眯着眼睛，望向陈青云。“杨县长，谢谢您把我调回秘书科，一点薄礼，不成敬意！”陈青云拿出准备好的烟酒，递给了他。岂料，杨天明却一脸鄙夷，直接丢在地上，骂骂咧咧：“我平时喝的都是30年的老茅台，拿这种破烂货，是看不起我么？”陈青云没想到他架子这么大，一时有些尴尬。“陈秘书，我是看在小颜的面子上，才帮你调回县政府办！不过想要投靠我，你也得证明自己的价值，知道么？”杨天明说道。“杨县长，您这是什么意思？”陈青云问道。“你是唐志华的秘书，和他夫人白婉茹关系不错吧？唐志华虽然死了，但留下了不少财产和秘密，你找个晚上，帮我约一下白婉茹……”说着，杨天明的眸中，闪烁着贪婪的光芒。“好，我明白。”陈青云表面答应，但心中警惕起来。杨天明这个王八蛋，恐怕是动了邪念，想要欺负白婉茹这个寡妇，甚至财色兼收。当然，陈青云可不会让他得逞。“只要你办成这件事，我也不会亏待你的！对了，行政科有个女孩叫赵婉清，背景不简单，你想办法和她搞好关系，少不了好处！”杨天明又说道。赵婉清？一时间，陈青云的脑海中，浮现出一道白裙飘飘的倩影。她和自己一起面试，考入的松山县政府办，因为长相太过出众，身边追求者无数。但她性格清冷，独来独往，根本不给那些追求者机会。没想到，她竟然来头不小！接下来，陈青云又主动敬酒，说自己是江颜的远房表弟，那就是杨天明的人，一定会帮他去约白婉茹。杨天明想到马上能拿下白婉茹这个县长夫人，也十分开心，又喝了几大杯白酒，很快就醉倒趴在桌子上了。“青云弟，你和我一起，把他扛进卧室去！”江颜开口道。

“好。”两人扛着杨天明上楼，将他丢在了卧室的大床上。此刻，杨天明已经不省人事，甚至打起了呼噜。江颜累得香汗淋漓，胸口起伏的同时，深邃沟壑若隐若现。“咕咚！”陈青云吞了吞口水，只觉得一片雪白，根本挪不开眼。“青云，谢谢你帮忙……”江颜望了过去，却发现他在偷看自己，俏脸顿时涨得通红。“颜姐，我不是故意的！”陈青云有些尴尬，正想要解释。“叮铃铃！”突然，杨天明的手机响了，两人吓得立刻分开，下意识望了过去。只见屏幕上，显示“高露”发来了一条消息。“这么晚了，高主任找杨县长，有什么急事么？”陈青云心生好奇，拿起手机，扫了扫杨天明的脸来解锁。很快，就看到三行劲爆的文字——【亲爱的，你刚才好猛，让人家都丢了三次！】【你老婆那个不下蛋的鸡，根本给不了你这样的快乐吧？】【别忘了你答应过，只要我怀上孩子，就要甩了她离婚娶我！】一时间，陈青云惊呆了。没想到在单位一向冷傲的高露，竟然和杨天明有一腿，难怪白天她……“这对狗男女！”江颜更是气的牙痒痒，捏紧了香拳。“杨天明在外面拈花惹草，说是男人的应酬，我都忍了！现在他竟然为了一个狐狸精要离婚，要把我一脚踹开？做梦！”“嘘……颜姐，小声点，万一把杨县长吵醒怎么办？”陈青云压低声音，劝她冷静。“放心吧！杨天明喝醉了睡得很死，就算外面敲锣打鼓，他都不会醒来！”江颜解释道。“那就好……”陈青云这才松了口气。然而下一刻，江颜的两条玉臂却搂住他的脖子，火热性感的娇躯如同水蛇般贴了过来。两人肌肤相亲，严丝合缝。“颜姐，你这是……”陈青云瞬间亢奋起来，昂扬的不行。“青云，你想不想要我？就在这屋子里给杨天明戴绿帽子？”江颜轻舔红唇，说出一句让陈青云热血沸腾的话。“颜姐，你是认真的？”话刚说完，江颜便抓住陈青云的手探入自己的旗袍之中。陈青云手掌感受到那软玉温香的肌肤，激动的浑身颤抖，不自觉揉捏起来……　　请记住本书首发域名：fzhldax。顶点小说网手机版阅读网址：fzhldax

Jiang Yan had obviously dressed up. She was wearing a goose-yellow cheongsam. The skirt was slit to the top of her thighs, exposing her beautiful white legs. Coupled with her beautiful face, it was simply tempting and criminal."Qingyun, why are you in a daze? Come in quickly!" Jiang Yan urged."Sister Yan, you are so beautiful! If you were not married, I would definitely be waiting at your door every day to pursue you..." Chen Qingyun swallowed, his eyes burning.Sensing his gaze, Jiang Yan was shy and a little happy at the same time, and quickly pulled him in."You can rest in the living room for a while, and I'll cook two more dishes!" Jiang Yan walked into the kitchen and soon prepared a table of sumptuous dishes, all delicious and delicious.However, when the appointed time came, Yang Tianming did not show up.Jiang Yan wanted to call to urge her, but Chen Qingyun held her hand: "Sister Yan, Deputy County Magistrate Yang is busy with official duties and is probably working overtime. I should wait!" "Okay then." Jiang Yan nodded.This wait lasted more than two hours.The food on the table was all cold, and Yang Tianming came back drunk. He had obviously just been socializing outside, and he still smelled of women's perfume."Tianming, why did you come back just now? Didn't I tell you that my distant cousin is coming to treat you to dinner?" Jiang Yan looked cold and a little unhappy."There is a dinner party that I really can't turn down! Is this your distant relative?" Yang Tianming half-squinted his eyes and looked at Chen Qingyun."County Magistrate Yang, thank you for transferring me back to the secretarial department. A small gift would be disrespectful!" Chen Qingyun took out the cigarettes and wine he had prepared and handed them to him.Unexpectedly, Yang Tianming had a look of disdain on his face and threw it directly to the ground, cursing: "I usually drink 30-year-old Moutai. Are you looking down on me with this kind of junk?" Chen Qingyun didn't expect that he would be so arrogant, and was a little embarrassed for a moment."Secretary Chen, I transferred you back to the county government office for Xiaoyan's sake! But if you want to join me, you have to prove your worth, you know?" Yang Tianming said."County Magistrate Yang, what do you mean?" Chen Qingyun asked."You are Tang Zhihua's secretary, and you have a good relationship with his wife Bai Wanru, right? Although Tang Zhihua died, he left behind a lot of property and secrets. Find a night and help me make an appointment with Bai Wanru..." As he spoke, Yang Tianming's eyes shone with greed.“好，我明白。”陈青云表面答应，但心中警惕起来。Yang Tianming, the bastard, might have evil thoughts and want to bully Bai Wanru, the widow, and even get rich and rich.Of course, Chen Qingyun will not let him succeed."As long as you succeed in this matter, I won't treat you badly! By the way, there is a girl named Zhao Wanqing in the administrative department. Her background is not simple. If you find a way to have a good relationship with her, there will be many benefits!" Yang Tianming added.Zhao Wanqing?For a moment, a beautiful figure in a fluttering white dress appeared in Chen Qingyun's mind.She interviewed with herself and was admitted to the Songshan County Government Office. Because her appearance was so outstanding, she had countless suitors around her.But she has a cold personality, keeps to herself, and doesn't give those suitors a chance at all.Unexpectedly, she has quite a lot of background!Next, Chen Qingyun took the initiative to toast again, saying that he was Jiang Yan's distant cousin, that is Yang Tianming's person, and would definitely help him make an appointment with Bai Wanru.Yang Tianming was very happy when he thought that he could win Bai Wanru, the county magistrate's wife, immediately. He drank a few more glasses of liquor and soon fell drunk on the table."Brother Qingyun, come with me and carry him into the bedroom!" Jiang Yan said.

"Okay." The two of them carried Yang Tianming upstairs and threw him on the big bed in the bedroom.At this moment, Yang Tianming was unconscious and even snoring.Jiang Yan was so tired that he was dripping with sweat. While his chest was rising and falling, deep ravines were looming."Gudong!" Chen Qingyun swallowed his saliva, feeling all white and unable to move his eyes away at all."Qingyun, thank you for your help..." Jiang Yan looked over, only to find that he was peeking at her, and her pretty face suddenly turned red."Sister Yan, I didn't mean it!" Chen Qingyun was a little embarrassed and was about to explain."Ding ding ding!" Suddenly, Yang Tianming's cell phone rang. The two of them were so frightened that they immediately separated and looked over subconsciously.只见屏幕上，显示“高露”发来了一条消息。"It's so late. Director Gao is looking for County Magistrate Yang. Is there anything urgent?" Chen Qingyun was curious, picked up the phone, and scanned Yang Tianming's face to unlock it.Soon, I saw three lines of explosive text - [Dear, you were so fierce just now, I even lost you three times!】【Your wife's chicken that doesn't lay eggs can't give you such happiness at all, can it?】【Don’t forget you promised that as long as I get pregnant with a child, you will dump her, divorce her and marry me!] For a moment, Chen Qingyun was stunned.Unexpectedly, Gao Lu, who was always cold and arrogant in the workplace, would actually have an affair with Yang Tianming. No wonder during the day she... "What a couple!" Jiang Yan was even more angry and itched her teeth and clenched her fists."Yang Tianming was flirting with women outside, saying it was a man's entertainment, but I couldn't bear it! Now he wants a divorce for a vixen and wants to kick me away? I'm dreaming!" "Shh... Sister Yan, lower your voice. What if County Magistrate Yang is woken up?" Chen Qingyun lowered his voice and advised her to calm down."Don't worry! Yang Tianming fell into a deep sleep when he was drunk. Even if gongs and drums were beating outside, he would not wake up!" Jiang Yan explained."That's good..." Chen Qingyun breathed a sigh of relief.However, the next moment, Jiang Yan's two jade arms hugged his neck, and her hot and sexy body pressed against him like a water snake.The two of them were skin-to-skin, a perfect fit."Sister Yan, what are you..." Chen Qingyun instantly became excited and extremely high-spirited."Qingyun, do you want me to cuckold Yang Tianming in this room?" Jiang Yan licked her red lips and said something that made Chen Qingyun's blood boil."Sister Yan, are you serious?" As soon as he finished speaking, Jiang Yan grabbed Chen Qingyun's hand and put it into her cheongsam.Chen Qingyun felt the warm and fragrant jade skin with his palms, and his whole body trembled with excitement, and he kneaded it unconsciously...
